reason: The flat toolbar is new in this change, so no earlier commit holds it. The browser test apps/web/src/features/paper/editor/chrome/paper-toolbar.browser.test.ts measures the live toolbar at 1440 and 390 and feeds the measurement to detect; the fixtures replay the old toolbar's failure of headings and lists hidden behind More at 1440. Caught by gate G1 (#2267). Introduced by 31312de3d (#2241): at 320 More and Align sat past the edge, at 200% text the style and font labels cut their text, and Escape from a menu sent focus to the page. The measure-based detect has no source file to replay, so the proof is the browser test run against 6e3809f93 with this change's tests: 4 of 9 fail there (More clips at 320px, Text style cuts its text at 390px, Escape from File moves focus to Paper page, print shows the toolbar) and 9 of 9 pass with the fix. Caught again by gate G1 run 2 (#2279): Escape from a menu opened by pointer sent focus to its button, so a letter typed next was lost to the page. Introduced by 99edc144e (#2273). Proof: the new pointer browser test against 99edc144e's menu-return.ts fails on all 5 menus (Escape from File opened by pointer moves focus to File) and passes with the fix; Escape from a menu opened from the keyboard still returns to its button. Caught again on the switch branch (#2287): Escape from Align opened by pointer left focus on Align now and then in ci, because the page took focus only in finalFocus, which Base UI calls when the popup unmounts a frame or an exit motion after the close, and the closing popup carries its button's label. Introduced by 842615f56 (#2281). Proof: the browser test that holds the popup's exit for 800ms fails on all 5 menus against 842615f56's menu-return.ts (Escape from Align opened by pointer moves focus to Align) and passes once the page takes focus in onOpenChange at the close.
